How Bilingual Reading Helps Learners

Reading a text side by side with its translation lets learners check their understanding without losing the flow of the original.

Researchers at several universities found that readers who used parallel texts remembered more vocabulary after two weeks.

Why it works

  • The original keeps the author's voice and rhythm.
  • The translation resolves ambiguous phrases immediately.
  • Switching between both builds confidence over time.

Install the tool with npm install parallel-reader and run it from your terminal.

const reader = new ParallelReader();
reader.open("book.txt");
Tip: start with short news articles before moving on to novels.
